newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein easier, demand poor.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein easier, demand poor.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were mostly stable in slow late trading on Monday as buyers turned cautious following sharp falls in Malaysia.
Traders said olein stayed at around 1,455-60 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, while one player was offering 1,430 rupiah. Olein was quoted at 1,395 rupiah in the North Sumatran city of Medan.
"The sharp falls in Malaysia made buyers nervous," one trader said. "They (buyers) are holding out, waiting to see how the market will develop tomorrow."
Traders said there had been an easing in the short supply of prompt-delivery olein in Jakarta.
They said fresh shipments were starting to arrive in Jakarta, including one cargo of 1,000 tonnes that left Belawan Port on Friday and another 1,500 tonnes that left on Thursday.
The traders said buyers were also waiting to see if state logistics agency BULOG would take further action to cool local prices to its target of 1,400-1,450 rupiah/kg.
